# WalletConnect v2 Examples

Catalogue of various wallet and dapp examples implementing WalletConnect's **SDKs and APIs**. Each example contains its own README with further instructions and explanations.

### Wallets

- [React Wallet v2](https://github.com/reown-com/web-examples/tree/main/advanced/wallets/react-wallet-v2)

### dApps

- [React dApp v2](https://github.com/reown-com/web-examples/tree/main/advanced/dapps/react-dapp-v2)
- [Chain Abstraction Demo](https://github.com/reown-com/web-examples/tree/main/advanced/dapps/chain-abstraction-demo)
- [Smart Sessions Demo](https://github.com/reown-com/web-examples/tree/main/advanced/dapps/smart-sessions-demo)
